single_change: Final fusion is limited to the positive support of the union of accepted warped foreground coverage.
formula: D={i:prior_i>0}; z_i=(1-w)*clip(base_i,0,1)+w*prior_i if i in D, otherwise z_i=base_i. w is the original geometry_weight=0.5.
local_domain: Union of positive warped reference foreground coverage from retained poses, including fractional bilinear coverage. No bounding-box expansion, dilation, new threshold, or new parameter.
preserved: v1 reference clustering, foreground purity, landmark selection and weighting
v1 part responses, peaks, pose proposals, held-out validation and NMS
all v1 Config values and token-grid geometry; no original-aspect-ratio restoration
v1 exact final arithmetic inside the local domain

predictions.mathematical: Outside D the base field is preserved value-for-value, including values outside [0,1]. No accepted pose gives D empty and retains the whole base.
predictions.conditional: A correct base instance outside accepted warped support is not globally suppressed merely because another pose was accepted.

counterexamples: Pose-unsupported false targets present in the base are now preserved as well.
An accepted wrong pose can still add false foreground within its warped silhouette.
Partial coverage can still reduce the base inside D and delete a correct boundary.
Reference/query aspect mismatch, articulation and multi-instance reference landmark issues are inherited unchanged.
extra_cpu_cost: One reused v1 prediction plus O(N) masking/copy; controls reuse that same pose calculation. Actual complete cost remains unmeasured.
planned_comparison: Primary agent will bind to the same authorized real 600 episodes and compare v2 with fixed global v1, same-rendering base and bag controls. No real run performed by this local worker.
